senses.en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.

ex.en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
ex.zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。

ex.en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
ex.zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。

col: a slice of pizza｜一片比萨
tip: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

senses.en: Related items or names written one below another.
To write or state items one after another.

ex.en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
ex.zh: 出门前，我列了一张购物清单。

ex.en: The report lists several practical measures that cities can adopt to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 这份报告列出了城市可以采取的几项缓解交通拥堵的实用措施。

tip: 在名单上用on the list，不用in。

senses.en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

col: my own room｜我自己的房间
of your own｜属于你自己的
tip: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

senses.en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
ex.zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: Used to give an example of what you mean.

ex.en: Many animals live in nature, for example, birds and insects.
ex.zh: 许多动物生活在大自然中，例如鸟类和昆虫。

ex.en: I like sports, for example, football and tennis.
ex.zh: 我喜欢运动，例如足球和网球。

tip: for example 后通常加逗号，缩写是 e.g.。

senses.en: a system of words or gestures used for communication
the words and style used in a particular context

ex.en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
ex.zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。

ex.en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
ex.zh: 学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。

tip: 指某种语言时可数；泛指语言能力时常不可数。

senses.en: Involving two or more countries.
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。

ex.en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。

tip: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。

ex.en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。

tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

senses.en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement
past tense and past participle of find

ex.en: My aunt founded a small charity last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天，我姑姑创办了一家小型慈善机构。

ex.en: Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.
ex.zh: 创办新企业的毕业生可以创造就业机会，并为当地社区引入创新服务。

col: found a charity｜创办慈善机构
tip: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

senses.en: Important and full of meaning; worth doing.

ex.en: Reading is a meaningful hobby.
ex.zh: 阅读是一种有意义的爱好。

ex.en: We do meaningful things on PLA Day.
ex.zh: 我们在建军节做有意义的事情。

senses.en: To hope for something special, often on your birthday.

ex.en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
ex.zh: 闭上眼睛许个愿吧。

ex.en: She makes a wish before she blows out the candles.
ex.zh: 她在吹灭蜡烛之前许了个愿。

senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
ex.zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。

ex.en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。

col: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动
tip: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.
To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。

ex.en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

col: apply for a post｜申请职位
tip: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你丢了钥匙，请联系接待员。

ex.en: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 经常与家人联系可以减轻独居老年人的孤独感。

col: keep in contact with｜与……保持联系
tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。

senses.en: Something that represents an idea, quality, or group.
A written mark used to represent information.

ex.en: For my grandparents, this old house is a symbol of hope.
ex.zh: 对我的祖父母来说，这座老房子是希望的象征。

ex.en: Public parks can become a symbol of a city's commitment to environmental protection and residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 公共公园可以成为城市致力于环境保护和提升居民生活质量的象征。

col: a symbol of peace｜和平的象征
a status symbol｜身份地位的象征
tip: “……的象征”用 a symbol of，不用 symbol for。

senses.en: To make one picture with a camera or phone.

ex.en: Let me take a photo of the Great Wall.
ex.zh: 让我拍一张长城的照片。

ex.en: He takes a photo of his friends.
ex.zh: 他给他朋友们拍了一张照片。

tip: take a photo 指拍一张；take photos 泛指拍照。

senses.en: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside.
The people who live in a village, considered together.

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

tip: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。

senses.en: To become bigger or develop over time.
To raise plants for food or other purposes.
To gradually become different in condition or feeling.

ex.en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。

ex.en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
ex.zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。

col: grow increasingly concerned｜变得越来越担忧
tip: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
ex.zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。

ex.en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
ex.zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

senses.en: To stop a flame burning by blowing on it.

ex.en: Blow out the candles on your birthday cake.
ex.zh: 吹灭生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。

ex.en: She blows out all the candles in one go.
ex.zh: 她一口气吹灭了所有的蜡烛。

senses.en: get pleasure from an activity or experience
have something good, such as a right or advantage

ex.en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。

ex.en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。

tip: 接动词时用-ing形式，不用to do。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

col: average height｜平均身高；平均高度
at a height of｜在……的高度
at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: at a time after now or another mentioned time
happening or existing after another time or stage

ex.en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
ex.zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。

ex.en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
ex.zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。

col: at a later stage｜在较后的阶段
tip: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。

senses.en: On the following occasion; another time in the future.

ex.en: See you next time!
ex.zh: 下次见！

ex.en: Next time, please come earlier.
ex.zh: 下次请早点来。

senses.en: Used to ask about the person who receives an action (object form of who).

ex.en: Whom do you want to speak to?
ex.zh: 你想跟谁说话？

ex.en: The teacher whom we met is kind.
ex.zh: 我们遇到的那位老师很和蔼。

tip: whom 是 who 的宾格形式，口语中常用 who 代替。

senses.en: The famous English writer of plays and poems (1564–1616).

ex.en: William Shakespeare was a famous writer in England.
ex.zh: 威廉·莎士比亚是英国一位著名的作家。

ex.en: We learn about William Shakespeare in English class.
ex.zh: 我们在英语课上了解威廉·莎士比亚。

senses.en: The famous British nurse known as the founder of modern nursing.
senses.zh: 弗洛伦斯 · 南丁格尔

ex.en: Florence Nightingale was a great nurse.
ex.zh: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔是一位伟大的护士。

ex.en: We learn the story of Florence Nightingale at school.
ex.zh: 我们在学校学习弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔的故事。

senses.en: The national holiday of China, on 1st October.

ex.en: National Day is on 1st October.
ex.zh: 国庆节是10月1日。

ex.en: We have a holiday on National Day.
ex.zh: 国庆节我们放假。

senses.en: The day marking the founding of the Communist Party of China, 1st July.
senses.zh: 中国共产党建党纪念日

ex.en: CPC Founding Day is on 1st July.
ex.zh: 中国共产党建党纪念日是7月1日。

ex.en: We learn about CPC Founding Day in class.
ex.zh: 我们在课堂上了解中国共产党建党纪念日。

senses.en: The day marking the founding of the People's Liberation Army, 1st August.
senses.zh: 中国人民解放军建军节

ex.en: PLA Day is on 1st August.
ex.zh: 中国人民解放军建军节是8月1日。

ex.en: We visit the museum on PLA Day.
ex.zh: 建军节那天我们参观博物馆。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Judy is my pen friend.
ex.zh: 朱迪是我的笔友。

ex.en: Judy likes yogurt and chocolate.
ex.zh: 朱迪喜欢酸奶和巧克力。

senses.en: A family name.

ex.en: Mr Clark is our science teacher.
ex.zh: 克拉克先生是我们的科学老师。

ex.en: Her family name is Clark.
ex.zh: 她姓克拉克。
